engine: 1967 Volkswagen Type 2 T1 1500, naturally aspirated air-cooled flat-four

source.provenance: Generated with ChatGPT and supplied by the user for this mod.

runtime_loop.processing: 63-tap windowed-sinc anti-alias decimation and periodic 100 ms crossfade; no extra tones or noise

constant_drive_loop.provenance: Generated with ChatGPT and supplied by the user for this mod.
constant_drive_loop.processing: Used unchanged; pitch follows the measured approximately 70.6 Hz firing cadence through 2,300 RPM, equivalent to about 2,120 RPM at 1x pitch. Above 2,300 RPM the pitch response uses a 0.30 compression exponent, reaching about 1.31x at the 4,300 RPM limiter.

playback: The 740 RPM engine recording is used at idle and crossfades to the user-supplied driving loop between 1250 and 2300 RPM. Both loops match engine firing cadence across the crossfade; driving-loop pitch response is compressed above 2,300 RPM to retain the worn air-cooled engine character.
note: The user confirms the recordings were generated with ChatGPT and may be redistributed with this mod.
